arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ الر تِلكَ ءايٰتُ الكِتٰبِ وَقُرءانٍ مُبينٍ
transliteration: Aliflamra tilka ayatu alkitabi waquranin mubeenin
translation: Alif. Lam. Ra. These are verses of the Scripture and a plain Reading

arabic: رُبَما يَوَدُّ الَّذينَ كَفَروا لَو كانوا مُسلِمينَ
transliteration: Rubama yawaddu allatheena kafaroo law kanoo muslimeena
translation: It may be that those who disbelieve wish ardently that they were Muslims

arabic: ذَرهُم يَأكُلوا وَيَتَمَتَّعوا وَيُلهِهِمُ الأَمَلُ فَسَوفَ يَعلَمونَ
transliteration: Tharhum yakuloo wayatamattaAAoo wayulhihimu alamalu fasawfa yaAAlamoona
translation: Let them eat and enjoy life, and let (false) hope beguile them. They will come to know

arabic: وَما أَهلَكنا مِن قَريَةٍ إِلّا وَلَها كِتابٌ مَعلومٌ
transliteration: Wama ahlakna min qaryatin illa walaha kitabun maAAloomun
translation: And We destroyed no township but there was a known decree for it

arabic: ما تَسبِقُ مِن أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَها وَما يَستَـٔخِرونَ
transliteration: Ma tasbiqu min ommatin ajalaha wama yastakhiroona
translation: No nation can outstrip its term nor can they lag behind

arabic: وَقالوا يٰأَيُّهَا الَّذى نُزِّلَ عَلَيهِ الذِّكرُ إِنَّكَ لَمَجنونٌ
transliteration: Waqaloo ya ayyuha allathee nuzzila AAalayhi alththikru innaka lamajnoonun
translation: And they say: O thou unto whom the Reminder is revealed, lo! thou art indeed a madman

arabic: لَو ما تَأتينا بِالمَلٰئِكَةِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقينَ
transliteration: Law ma tateena bialmalaikati in kunta mina alssadiqeena
translation: Why bringest thou not angels unto us, if thou art of the truthful

arabic: ما نُنَزِّلُ المَلٰئِكَةَ إِلّا بِالحَقِّ وَما كانوا إِذًا مُنظَرينَ
transliteration: Ma nunazzilu almalaikata illa bialhaqqi wama kanoo ithan munthareena
translation: We send not down the angels save with the Fact, and in that case (the disbelievers) would not be tolerated

arabic: إِنّا نَحنُ نَزَّلنَا الذِّكرَ وَإِنّا لَهُ لَحٰفِظونَ
transliteration: Inna nahnu nazzalna alththikra wainna lahu lahafithoona
translation: Lo! We, even We, reveal the Reminder, and lo! We verily are its Guardian

arabic: وَلَقَد أَرسَلنا مِن قَبلِكَ فى شِيَعِ الأَوَّلينَ
transliteration: Walaqad arsalna min qablika fee shiyaAAi alawwaleena
translation: We verily sent (messengers) before thee among the factions of the men of old

arabic: وَما يَأتيهِم مِن رَسولٍ إِلّا كانوا بِهِ يَستَهزِءونَ
transliteration: Wama yateehim min rasoolin illa kanoo bihi yastahzioona
translation: And never came there unto them a messenger but they did mock him

arabic: كَذٰلِكَ نَسلُكُهُ فى قُلوبِ المُجرِمينَ
transliteration: Kathalika naslukuhu fee quloobi almujrimeena
translation: Thus do We make it traverse the hearts of the guilty

arabic: لا يُؤمِنونَ بِهِ وَقَد خَلَت سُنَّةُ الأَوَّلينَ
transliteration: La yuminoona bihi waqad khalat sunnatu alawwaleena
translation: They believe not therein, though the example of the men of old hath gone before

arabic: وَلَو فَتَحنا عَلَيهِم بابًا مِنَ السَّماءِ فَظَلّوا فيهِ يَعرُجونَ
transliteration: Walaw fatahna AAalayhim baban mina alssamai fathalloo feehi yaAArujoona
translation: And even if We opened unto them a gate of heaven and they kept mounting through it

arabic: لَقالوا إِنَّما سُكِّرَت أَبصٰرُنا بَل نَحنُ قَومٌ مَسحورونَ
transliteration: Laqaloo innama sukkirat absaruna bal nahnu qawmun mashooroona
translation: They would say: Our sight is wrong - nay, but we are folk bewitched

arabic: وَلَقَد جَعَلنا فِى السَّماءِ بُروجًا وَزَيَّنّٰها لِلنّٰظِرينَ
transliteration: Walaqad jaAAalna fee alssamai buroojan wazayyannaha lilnnathireena
translation: And verily in the heaven we have set mansions of the stars, and We have beautified it for beholders

arabic: وَحَفِظنٰها مِن كُلِّ شَيطٰنٍ رَجيمٍ
transliteration: Wahafithnaha min kulli shaytanin rajeemin
translation: And We have guarded it from every outcast devil

arabic: إِلّا مَنِ استَرَقَ السَّمعَ فَأَتبَعَهُ شِهابٌ مُبينٌ
transliteration: Illa mani istaraqa alssamAAa faatbaAAahu shihabun mubeenun
translation: Save him who stealeth the hearing, and them doth a clear flame pursue

arabic: وَالأَرضَ مَدَدنٰها وَأَلقَينا فيها رَوٰسِىَ وَأَنبَتنا فيها مِن كُلِّ شَيءٍ مَوزونٍ
transliteration: Waalarda madadnaha waalqayna feeha rawasiya waanbatna feeha min kulli shayin mawzoonin
translation: And the earth have We spread out, and placed therein firm hills, and caused each seemly thing to grow therein

arabic: وَجَعَلنا لَكُم فيها مَعٰيِشَ وَمَن لَستُم لَهُ بِرٰزِقينَ
transliteration: WajaAAalna lakum feeha maAAayisha waman lastum lahu biraziqeena
translation: And we have given unto you livelihoods therein, and unto those for whom ye provide not

arabic: وَإِن مِن شَيءٍ إِلّا عِندَنا خَزائِنُهُ وَما نُنَزِّلُهُ إِلّا بِقَدَرٍ مَعلومٍ
transliteration: Wain min shayin illa AAindana khazainuhu wama nunazziluhu illa biqadarin maAAloomin
translation: And there is not a thing but with Us are the stores thereof. And we send it not down save in appointed measure

arabic: وَأَرسَلنَا الرِّيٰحَ لَوٰقِحَ فَأَنزَلنا مِنَ السَّماءِ ماءً فَأَسقَينٰكُموهُ وَما أَنتُم لَهُ بِخٰزِنينَ
transliteration: Waarsalna alrriyaha lawaqiha faanzalna mina alssamai maan faasqaynakumoohu wama antum lahu bikhazineena
translation: And We send the winds fertilising, and cause water to descend from the sky, and give it you to drink. It is not ye who are the holders of the store thereof

arabic: وَإِنّا لَنَحنُ نُحيۦ وَنُميتُ وَنَحنُ الوٰرِثونَ
transliteration: Wainna lanahnu nuhyee wanumeetu wanahnu alwarithoona
translation: Lo! and it is We, even We, Who quicken and give death, and We are the Inheritor

arabic: وَلَقَد عَلِمنَا المُستَقدِمينَ مِنكُم وَلَقَد عَلِمنَا المُستَـٔخِرينَ
transliteration: Walaqad AAalimna almustaqdimeena minkum walaqad AAalimna almustakhireena
translation: And verily We know the eager among you and verily We know the laggards

arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحشُرُهُم إِنَّهُ حَكيمٌ عَليمٌ
transliteration: Wainna rabbaka huwa yahshuruhum innahu hakeemun AAaleemun
translation: Lo! thy Lord will gather them together. Lo! He is Wise, Aware

arabic: وَلَقَد خَلَقنَا الإِنسٰنَ مِن صَلصٰلٍ مِن حَمَإٍ مَسنونٍ
transliteration: Walaqad khalaqna alinsana min salsalin min hamain masnoonin
translation: Verily We created man of potter's clay of black mud altered

arabic: وَالجانَّ خَلَقنٰهُ مِن قَبلُ مِن نارِ السَّمومِ
transliteration: Waaljanna khalaqnahu min qablu min nari alssamoomi
translation: And the jinn did We create aforetime of essential fire

arabic: وَإِذ قالَ رَبُّكَ لِلمَلٰئِكَةِ إِنّى خٰلِقٌ بَشَرًا مِن صَلصٰلٍ مِن حَمَإٍ مَسنونٍ
transliteration: Waith qala rabbuka lilmalaikati innee khaliqun basharan min salsalin min hamain masnoonin
translation: And (remember) when thy Lord said unto the angels: Lo! I am creating a mortal out of potter's clay of black mud altered

arabic: فَإِذا سَوَّيتُهُ وَنَفَختُ فيهِ مِن روحى فَقَعوا لَهُ سٰجِدينَ
transliteration: Faitha sawwaytuhu wanafakhtu feehi min roohee faqaAAoo lahu sajideena
translation: So, when I have made him and have breathed into him of My Spirit, do ye fall down, prostrating yourselves unto him

arabic: فَسَجَدَ المَلٰئِكَةُ كُلُّهُم أَجمَعونَ
transliteration: Fasajada almalaikatu kulluhum ajmaAAoona
translation: So the angels fell prostrate, all of them together

arabic: إِلّا إِبليسَ أَبىٰ أَن يَكونَ مَعَ السّٰجِدينَ
transliteration: Illa ibleesa aba an yakoona maAAa alssajideena
translation: Save Iblis. He refused to be among the prostrate

arabic: قالَ يٰإِبليسُ ما لَكَ أَلّا تَكونَ مَعَ السّٰجِدينَ
transliteration: Qala ya ibleesu ma laka alla takoona maAAa alssajideena
translation: He said: O Iblis! What aileth thee that thou art not among the prostrate

arabic: قالَ لَم أَكُن لِأَسجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقتَهُ مِن صَلصٰلٍ مِن حَمَإٍ مَسنونٍ
transliteration: Qala lam akun liasjuda libasharin khalaqtahu min salsalin min hamain masnoonin
translation: He said: I am not one to prostrate myself unto a mortal whom Thou hast created out of potter's clay of black mud altered

arabic: قالَ فَاخرُج مِنها فَإِنَّكَ رَجيمٌ
transliteration: Qala faokhruj minha fainnaka rajeemun
translation: He said: Then go thou forth from hence, for lo! thou art outcast

arabic: وَإِنَّ عَلَيكَ اللَّعنَةَ إِلىٰ يَومِ الدّينِ
transliteration: Wainna AAalayka allaAAnata ila yawmi alddeeni
translation: And lo! the curse shall be upon thee till the Day of Judgment

arabic: قالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرنى إِلىٰ يَومِ يُبعَثونَ
transliteration: Qala rabbi faanthirnee ila yawmi yubAAathoona
translation: He said: My Lord! Reprieve me till the day when they are raised

arabic: قالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ المُنظَرينَ
transliteration: Qala fainnaka mina almunthareena
translation: He said: Then lo! thou art of those reprieved

arabic: إِلىٰ يَومِ الوَقتِ المَعلومِ
transliteration: Ila yawmi alwaqti almaAAloomi
translation: Till the Day of appointed time

arabic: قالَ رَبِّ بِما أَغوَيتَنى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُم فِى الأَرضِ وَلَأُغوِيَنَّهُم أَجمَعينَ
transliteration: Qala rabbi bima aghwaytanee laozayyinanna lahum fee alardi walaoghwiyannahum ajmaAAeena
translation: He said: My Lord! Because Thou hast sent me astray, I verily shall adorn the path of error for them in the earth, and shall mislead them every one

arabic: إِلّا عِبادَكَ مِنهُمُ المُخلَصينَ
transliteration: Illa AAibadaka minhumu almukhlaseena
translation: Save such of them as are Thy perfectly devoted slaves

arabic: قالَ هٰذا صِرٰطٌ عَلَىَّ مُستَقيمٌ
transliteration: Qala hatha siratun AAalayya mustaqeemun
translation: He said: This is a right course incumbent upon Me

arabic: إِنَّ عِبادى لَيسَ لَكَ عَلَيهِم سُلطٰنٌ إِلّا مَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ الغاوينَ
transliteration: Inna AAibadee laysa laka AAalayhim sultanun illa mani ittabaAAaka mina alghaweena
translation: Lo! as for My slaves, thou hast no power over any of them save such of the froward as follow thee

arabic: وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوعِدُهُم أَجمَعينَ
transliteration: Wainna jahannama lamawAAiduhum ajmaAAeena
translation: And lo! for all such, hell will be the promised place

arabic: لَها سَبعَةُ أَبوٰبٍ لِكُلِّ بابٍ مِنهُم جُزءٌ مَقسومٌ
transliteration: Laha sabAAatu abwabin likulli babin minhum juzon maqsoomun
translation: It hath seven gates, and each gate hath an appointed portion

arabic: إِنَّ المُتَّقينَ فى جَنّٰتٍ وَعُيونٍ
transliteration: Inna almuttaqeena fee jannatin waAAuyoonin
translation: Lo! those who ward off (evil) are among gardens and watersprings

arabic: ادخُلوها بِسَلٰمٍ ءامِنينَ
transliteration: Odkhulooha bisalamin amineena
translation: (And it is said unto them): Enter them in peace, secure

arabic: وَنَزَعنا ما فى صُدورِهِم مِن غِلٍّ إِخوٰنًا عَلىٰ سُرُرٍ مُتَقٰبِلينَ
transliteration: WanazaAAna ma fee sudoorihim min ghillin ikhwanan AAala sururin mutaqabileena
translation: And We remove whatever rancour may be in their breasts. As brethren, face to face, (they rest) on couches raised

arabic: لا يَمَسُّهُم فيها نَصَبٌ وَما هُم مِنها بِمُخرَجينَ
transliteration: La yamassuhum feeha nasabun wama hum minha bimukhrajeena
translation: Toil cometh not unto them there, nor will they be expelled from thence

arabic: نَبِّئ عِبادى أَنّى أَنَا الغَفورُ الرَّحيمُ
transliteration: Nabbi AAibadee annee ana alghafooru alrraheemu
translation: Announce, (O Muhammad) unto My slaves that verily I am the Forgiving, the Merciful

arabic: وَأَنَّ عَذابى هُوَ العَذابُ الأَليمُ
transliteration: Wa anna AAathabee huwa alAAathabu alaleemu
translation: And that My doom is the dolorous doom

arabic: وَنَبِّئهُم عَن ضَيفِ إِبرٰهيمَ
transliteration: Wanabbihum AAan dayfi ibraheema
translation: And tell them of Abraham's guests

arabic: إِذ دَخَلوا عَلَيهِ فَقالوا سَلٰمًا قالَ إِنّا مِنكُم وَجِلونَ
transliteration: Ith dakhaloo AAalayhi faqaloo salaman qala inna minkum wajiloona
translation: (How) when they came in unto him, and said: Peace. He said: Lo! we are afraid of you

arabic: قالوا لا تَوجَل إِنّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلٰمٍ عَليمٍ
transliteration: Qaloo la tawjal inna nubashshiruka bighulamin AAaleemin
translation: They said: Be not afraid! Lo! we bring thee good tidings of a boy possessing wisdom

arabic: قالَ أَبَشَّرتُمونى عَلىٰ أَن مَسَّنِىَ الكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرونَ
transliteration: Qala abashshartumoonee AAala an massaniya alkibaru fabima tubashshirooni
translation: He said: Bring ye me good tidings (of a son) when old age hath overtaken me? Of what then can ye bring good tidings

arabic: قالوا بَشَّرنٰكَ بِالحَقِّ فَلا تَكُن مِنَ القٰنِطينَ
transliteration: Qaloo bashsharnaka bialhaqqi fala takun mina alqaniteena
translation: They said: We bring thee good tidings in truth. So be not thou of the despairing

arabic: قالَ وَمَن يَقنَطُ مِن رَحمَةِ رَبِّهِ إِلَّا الضّالّونَ
transliteration: Qala waman yaqnatu min rahmati rabbihi illa alddalloona
translation: He said: And who despaireth of the mercy of his Lord save those who are astray

arabic: قالَ فَما خَطبُكُم أَيُّهَا المُرسَلونَ
transliteration: Qala fama khatbukum ayyuha almursaloona
translation: He said: And afterward what is your business, O ye messengers (of Allah)

arabic: قالوا إِنّا أُرسِلنا إِلىٰ قَومٍ مُجرِمينَ
transliteration: Qaloo inna orsilna ila qawmin mujrimeena
translation: They said: We have been sent unto a guilty folk

arabic: إِلّا ءالَ لوطٍ إِنّا لَمُنَجّوهُم أَجمَعينَ
transliteration: Illa ala lootin inna lamunajjoohum ajmaAAeena
translation: (All) save the family of Lot. Them we shall deliver every one

arabic: إِلَّا امرَأَتَهُ قَدَّرنا إِنَّها لَمِنَ الغٰبِرينَ
transliteration: Illa imraatahu qaddarna innaha lamina alghabireena
translation: Except his wife, of whom We had decreed that she should be of those who stay behind

arabic: فَلَمّا جاءَ ءالَ لوطٍ المُرسَلونَ
transliteration: Falamma jaa ala lootin almursaloona
translation: And when the messengers came unto the family of Lot

arabic: قالَ إِنَّكُم قَومٌ مُنكَرونَ
transliteration: Qala innakum qawmun munkaroona
translation: He said: Lo! ye are folk unknown (to me)

arabic: قالوا بَل جِئنٰكَ بِما كانوا فيهِ يَمتَرونَ
transliteration: Qaloo bal jinaka bima kanoo feehi yamtaroona
translation: They said: Nay, but we bring thee that concerning which they keep disputing

arabic: وَأَتَينٰكَ بِالحَقِّ وَإِنّا لَصٰدِقونَ
transliteration: Waataynaka bialhaqqi wainna lasadiqoona
translation: And bring thee the Truth, and lo! we are truth-tellers

arabic: فَأَسرِ بِأَهلِكَ بِقِطعٍ مِنَ الَّيلِ وَاتَّبِع أَدبٰرَهُم وَلا يَلتَفِت مِنكُم أَحَدٌ وَامضوا حَيثُ تُؤمَرونَ
transliteration: Faasri biahlika biqitAAin mina allayli waittabiAA adbarahum wala yaltafit minkum ahadun waimdoo haythu tumaroona
translation: So travel with thy household in a portion of the night, and follow thou their backs. Let none of you turn round, but go whither ye are commanded

arabic: وَقَضَينا إِلَيهِ ذٰلِكَ الأَمرَ أَنَّ دابِرَ هٰؤُلاءِ مَقطوعٌ مُصبِحينَ
transliteration: Waqadayna ilayhi thalika alamra anna dabira haolai maqtooAAun musbiheena
translation: And We made plain the case to him, that the root of them (who did wrong) was to be cut at early morn

arabic: وَجاءَ أَهلُ المَدينَةِ يَستَبشِرونَ
transliteration: Wajaa ahlu almadeenati yastabshiroona
translation: And the people of the city came, rejoicing at the news (of new arrivals)

arabic: قالَ إِنَّ هٰؤُلاءِ ضَيفى فَلا تَفضَحونِ
transliteration: Qala inna haolai dayfee fala tafdahooni
translation: He said: Lo! they are my guests. Affront me not

arabic: وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَلا تُخزونِ
transliteration: Waittaqoo Allaha wala tukhzooni
translation: And keep your duty to Allah, and shame me not

arabic: قالوا أَوَلَم نَنهَكَ عَنِ العٰلَمينَ
transliteration: Qaloo awalam nanhaka AAani alAAalameena
translation: They said; Have we not forbidden you from (entertaining) anyone

arabic: قالَ هٰؤُلاءِ بَناتى إِن كُنتُم فٰعِلينَ
transliteration: Qala haolai banatee in kuntum faAAileena
translation: He said: Here are my daughters, if ye must be doing (so)

arabic: لَعَمرُكَ إِنَّهُم لَفى سَكرَتِهِم يَعمَهونَ
transliteration: LaAAamruka innahum lafee sakratihim yaAAmahoona
translation: By thy life (O Muhammad) they moved blindly in the frenzy of approaching death

arabic: فَأَخَذَتهُمُ الصَّيحَةُ مُشرِقينَ
transliteration: Faakhathathumu alssayhatu mushriqeena
translation: Then the (Awful) Cry overtook them at the sunrise

arabic: فَجَعَلنا عٰلِيَها سافِلَها وَأَمطَرنا عَلَيهِم حِجارَةً مِن سِجّيلٍ
transliteration: FajaAAalna AAaliyaha safilaha waamtarna AAalayhim hijaratan min sijjeelin
translation: And We utterly confounded them, and We rained upon them stones of heated clay

arabic: إِنَّ فى ذٰلِكَ لَءايٰتٍ لِلمُتَوَسِّمينَ
transliteration: Inna fee thalika laayatin lilmutawassimeena
translation: Lo! therein verily are portents for those who read the signs

arabic: وَإِنَّها لَبِسَبيلٍ مُقيمٍ
transliteration: Wainnaha labisabeelin muqeemin
translation: And lo! it is upon a road still uneffaced

arabic: إِنَّ فى ذٰلِكَ لَءايَةً لِلمُؤمِنينَ
transliteration: Inna fee thalika laayatan lilmumineena
translation: Lo! therein is indeed a portent for believers

arabic: وَإِن كانَ أَصحٰبُ الأَيكَةِ لَظٰلِمينَ
transliteration: Wain kana ashabu alaykati lathalimeena
translation: And the dwellers in the wood indeed were evil-doers

arabic: فَانتَقَمنا مِنهُم وَإِنَّهُما لَبِإِمامٍ مُبينٍ
transliteration: Faintaqamna minhum wainnahuma labiimamin mubeenin
translation: So we took vengeance on them; and lo! they both are on a high-road plain to see

arabic: وَلَقَد كَذَّبَ أَصحٰبُ الحِجرِ المُرسَلينَ
transliteration: Walaqad kaththaba ashabu alhijri almursaleena
translation: And the dwellers in Al-Hijr denied (Our) messengers

arabic: وَءاتَينٰهُم ءايٰتِنا فَكانوا عَنها مُعرِضينَ
transliteration: Waataynahum ayatina fakanoo AAanha muAArideena
translation: And we gave them Our revelations, but they were averse to them

arabic: وَكانوا يَنحِتونَ مِنَ الجِبالِ بُيوتًا ءامِنينَ
transliteration: Wakanoo yanhitoona mina aljibali buyootan amineena
translation: And they used to hew out dwellings from the hills, (wherein they dwelt) secure

arabic: فَأَخَذَتهُمُ الصَّيحَةُ مُصبِحينَ
transliteration: Faakhathathumu alssayhatu musbiheena
translation: But the (Awful) Cry overtook them at the morning hour

arabic: فَما أَغنىٰ عَنهُم ما كانوا يَكسِبونَ
transliteration: Fama aghna AAanhum ma kanoo yaksiboona
translation: And that which they were wont to count as gain availed them not

arabic: وَما خَلَقنَا السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضَ وَما بَينَهُما إِلّا بِالحَقِّ وَإِنَّ السّاعَةَ لَءاتِيَةٌ فَاصفَحِ الصَّفحَ الجَميلَ
transliteration: Wama khalaqna alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma illa bialhaqqi wainna alssaAAata laatiyatun faisfahi alssafha aljameela
translation: We created not the heavens and the earth and all that is between them save with truth, and lo! the Hour is surely coming. So forgive, (O Muhammad), with a gracious forgiveness

arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ الخَلّٰقُ العَليمُ
transliteration: Inna rabbaka huwa alkhallaqu alAAaleemu
translation: Lo! Thy Lord! He is the All-Wise Creator

arabic: وَلَقَد ءاتَينٰكَ سَبعًا مِنَ المَثانى وَالقُرءانَ العَظيمَ
transliteration: Walaqad ataynaka sabAAan mina almathanee waalqurana alAAatheema
translation: We have given thee seven of the oft-repeated (verses) and the great Qur'an

arabic: لا تَمُدَّنَّ عَينَيكَ إِلىٰ ما مَتَّعنا بِهِ أَزوٰجًا مِنهُم وَلا تَحزَن عَلَيهِم وَاخفِض جَناحَكَ لِلمُؤمِنينَ
transliteration: La tamuddanna AAaynayka ila ma mattaAAna bihi azwajan minhum wala tahzan AAalayhim waikhfid janahaka lilmumineena
translation: Strain not thine eyes toward that which We cause some wedded pairs among them to enjoin, and be not grieved on their account, and lower thy wing (in tenderness) for the believers

arabic: وَقُل إِنّى أَنَا النَّذيرُ المُبينُ
transliteration: Waqul innee ana alnnatheeru almubeenu
translation: And say: Lo! I, even I, am a plain warner

arabic: كَما أَنزَلنا عَلَى المُقتَسِمينَ
transliteration: Kama anzalna AAala almuqtasimeena
translation: Such as We send down for those who make division

arabic: الَّذينَ جَعَلُوا القُرءانَ عِضينَ
transliteration: Allatheena jaAAaloo alqurana AAideena
translation: Those who break the Qur'an into parts

arabic: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسـَٔلَنَّهُم أَجمَعينَ
transliteration: Fawarabbika lanasalannahum ajmaAAeena
translation: Them, by thy Lord, We shall question, every one

arabic: عَمّا كانوا يَعمَلونَ
transliteration: AAamma kanoo yaAAmaloona
translation: Of what they used to do

arabic: فَاصدَع بِما تُؤمَرُ وَأَعرِض عَنِ المُشرِكينَ
transliteration: FaisdaAA bima tumaru waaAArid AAani almushrikeena
translation: So proclaim that which thou art commanded, and withdraw from the idolaters

arabic: إِنّا كَفَينٰكَ المُستَهزِءينَ
transliteration: Inna kafaynaka almustahzieena
translation: Lo! We defend thee from the scoffers

arabic: الَّذينَ يَجعَلونَ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلٰهًا ءاخَرَ فَسَوفَ يَعلَمونَ
transliteration: Allatheena yajAAaloona maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara fasawfa yaAAlamoona
translation: Who set some other god along with Allah. But they will come to know

arabic: وَلَقَد نَعلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضيقُ صَدرُكَ بِما يَقولونَ
transliteration: Walaqad naAAlamu annaka yadeequ sadruka bima yaqooloona
translation: Well know We that thy bosom is oppressed by what they say

arabic: فَسَبِّح بِحَمدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُن مِنَ السّٰجِدينَ
transliteration: Fasabbih bihamdi rabbika wakun mina alssajideena
translation: But hymn the praise of thy Lord, and be of those who make prostration (unto Him)

arabic: وَاعبُد رَبَّكَ حَتّىٰ يَأتِيَكَ اليَقينُ
transliteration: WaoAAbud rabbaka hatta yatiyaka alyaqeenu
translation: And serve thy Lord till the Inevitable cometh unto thee
